stages.name: Radar Archive Pipeline
stages.notes: Windows Task Scheduler auto-collecting PNGs every 5min since 2026-05-22. Audit 2026-07-10: 11,705 PNGs, radar.zarr has 11,610 frames current through 2026-07-10 00:05 UTC — 49/90 days (~54%). All 4 SG-Weather scheduled tasks ran today with LastResult 0. Coverage: 35 of 47 complete days >=240 frames; low days (travel/shutdown): Jun 21 (222), Jun 28 (182), Jun 30 (234), Jul 7 (228), Jul 9 (196). Mean frames/day: Jun 272.6, Jul 265.3. PNG->zarr ingest automated via '\SG-Weather\SG-Weather Radar Preprocess' daily 08:00 SGT. Target: 90 days = ~Aug 20, 2026. FIX 2026-07-10: zarr time axis had 13 monotonicity violations (batch appends backfilled older frames); archive re-sorted via preprocess_radar.py --repair and ensure_sorted_archive() now enforces global order after every append — required for RadarDataset positional windows (Stage 4) and frame lookups. Known QC item: at least one all-NaN frame (blank scrape, e.g. near 2026-06-25 22:40 UTC).

stages.name: Diffusion Nowcaster Training
stages.notes: Blocked until Stage 3 reaches 90-day archive (~late August 2026). UNet + DDPM + RadarDataset + train.py already implemented. Smoke-test 2026-06-16: 100 steps, batch 2, grad-checkpointing on RTX 4060 (7GB) — NO OOM, 25.8M params, loss 1.12->0.52. One fp16 nan at step 20 (GradScaler skipped+recovered, benign during warmup). NOTE: train.py writes stage4_complete.flag whenever step==max_steps, so the smoke run falsely created the flag + toy checkpoints; cleaned up. Needs a guard before real runs. Env gap: tensorboard (in requirements.txt) was missing from the system Python3.12 runtime; pip-installed.

stages.name: Evaluation & Flash Flood Map
stages.notes: Ground-truth pipeline live: collect_flood_labels.py (Telegram, daily 09:00 SGT scheduled task, conda env) -> flood_labels.parquet; build_flood_eval_dataset.py cross-references labels to radar.zarr -> flood_eval_dataset.parquet. CRITICAL FIX 2026-07-10: '[HH:MM hours]' tags in PUB messages are SGT wall-clock but were stored as UTC — every label was 8h late and all geocoded flood cells read 0.0 mm/hr (see lessons L009; supersedes the L007/L008 'verified' claim). Collector now parses SGT -> UTC (nearest-day resolution); parquet rebuilt from raw messages.json. Rebuilt eval dataset 2026-07-10: 34 labels through 2026-07-08 (23 RAIN_WARNING, 11 FLOOD_RISK, 0 FLASH_FLOOD), 31/34 radar-matched (11/11 flood events), rain now visible at geocoded cells (e.g. Jalan Boon Lay 4.7 mm/hr near-cell at warning minute). Geocode cache: all 10 strings resolved — KPE slip-road hand-fixed 2026-07-10 to the Buangkok East Drive junction (1.3775, 103.9090, cell 70,149); all 11 flood events now carry spatial cells. FULLY AUTOMATED 2026-07-10: 'SG-Weather Telegram Labels' task (daily 09:00 SGT, conda env) now chains collect -> geocode (cache/gazetteer first, OneMap failures degrade to unresolved without breaking the chain) -> build_flood_eval_dataset; ExecutionTimeLimit raised PT10M -> PT20M; chain verified end-to-end (exit 0, parquets refreshed). evaluation_report.json (2026-06-18) is a smoke-run placeholder — not a real result. NOT yet wired into evaluate.py (would change Stage 5 semantics; awaiting approval).
